pipeline_name: Swan LNG Terminal to Dahej LNG Terminal Gas Pipeline

verifications.note: HTTP 200 but url_verifier substring check misses on this large PDF (documented false negative). Downloaded and read with pdftotext -layout: 'Under Construction Dedicated Natural Gas Pipelines' table, Sr 21.18.NGPL: "Swan LNG Private Limited's RLNG Terminal at Jafrabad to GAIL's terminal at Dahej connecting to its integrated HVJ" — Entity GAIL, authorised 31.12.2021, 170 km, 7 MMSCMD, target Dec 2024, Gujarat. This matches the sheet's LengthKnownKm (170.00), Capacity (7.00 MMSCMD) AND StartYear1 (2024 target) all at once, and the same edition's 'Swan LNG...to GPPC Terminal, Jafrabad' (Sr 21.16.NGPL) and 'Swan LNG...to Hadala' (Sr 21.17.NGPL) entries are separate GSPL-held authorisations, confirming this specific GAIL-held line is the correct match for P3912 rather than one of Swan LNG's other two evacuation pipelines.

fills.researcher_notes: Second row of the shared GAIL-direct-operation answer (see P2212 above for the full statement: GAIL runs its own trunk lines directly, no SPV, applied identically here). The PNGRB register (Aug-2024 edition; url_verifier FAILs on this large PDF, a documented false negative, confirmed locally with pdftotext -layout) is a single strong, independent, non-GEM source naming GAIL as the authorised entity for exactly this Jafrabad-Dahej line, so tier is medium per protocol's '1 strong = medium' rule rather than high. A second, independent source was actively sought and not obtained: petrowatch.com's related article on this corridor (HPCL wants GAIL to extend pipeline to Chhara) returned HTTP 403 (paywall/anti-bot) via WebFetch; swanlng.co.in (the terminal operator's own site) failed DNS resolution from this environment; nsenergybusiness.com's Swan LNG Terminal project page was checked and does not mention this connecting pipeline at all. Not pursued further given the web-search budget for this session was exhausted mid-brief. This same register entry also corroborates the row's existing LengthKnownKm, Capacity and StartYear1 values, though those cells were not flagged in this brief so no separate fill is proposed for them here. Never cited gem.wiki or globalenergymonitor.org. Value UNCHANGED (Operator was blank); ref-only addition. Operator is written 'GAIL (India) Ltd' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'GAIL Ltd'.
